body.statement: Uniformly over \((i,t)\in G\times W\), for \(e\in\mathbb R^{I_{it}\times J_{it}}\), the first differential of the rank-\(r\) target-cell completion map at \(M^{it}=R_{it}M\) is \(\ell_{it}(e)=\sum_{j\in C(t)}a_{ij,t}e_{jt}+\sum_{s\in S}b_{t,s}e_{is}-\sum_{j\in C(t),s\in S}a_{ij,t}b_{t,s}e_{js}\). The minus donor-pre overlap term is part of the differential and is not a remainder.
body.justification: A growing target window makes the overlap score load-bearing for both centering and variance.
body.gap: The pointwise Choi--Yuan decomposition displays donor-window and treated-pre leading terms; it does not state this full three-term aggregate differential.
body.consumer: The formula supplies the influence weights used by the finite-lag covariance estimator and prevents understated uncertainty for sustained policy effects.
